items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: So the only other thing that was happening was Louie Prima was down at the — what was that The Sahara?

ctx.x: Also we attracted all the musicians from the Strip to hear these two groups. So the place was booming. It was wonderful.

It was kind of like going to school. You know you’d go into the — because they’d let you go in the showroom in the back of the room and watch everybody that was there. And that was the most musical, that was the most musical place because most of the places didn’t have very good music, it was all kind of loud, bashey bands. So the only other thing that was happening was Louie Prima was down at the — what was that The Sahara?
